_about: All inputs for the EHD thruster analysis. Cleaned 2026-11-23: superseded and contradictory entries removed (wire is bare 36 AWG copper, not enamelled 28 AWG). Units are in the key names.
test_site: GITAM Visakhapatnam, 17.7806 N 83.3747 E, workshop without AC

emitter.wire: bare copper, 36 AWG (0.127 mm), gauge from memory (user-confirmed: no coating)
emitter.preparation: several small craft-knife cuts along each wire, only inside the 65 mm opening
emitter.face: inner face of the wire frame, facing the tubes (confirmed)

collector.tubes: 7 bare copper tubes, 6 mm OD, 85 mm long
collector.mounting: glued over 4.2 mm half-seats; tube surface protrudes 5.142 mm (centre 2.142 mm) beyond frame face, towards the wire frame

frame_gap_basis: 13 M8x1.25 thread crests between the frame faces
gap_definition: wire plane to tube front surface = frame gap - 5.142 mm
polarity_evidence: ~1 month of repeated tests: corona hiss at wire side in one lead orientation only; never in the reverse

air.source: Open-Meteo historical archive (reanalysis grid cell at 17.82N 83.37E, 43 m), hourly 12-15h
air.check: anemometer display read 33.6-33.7 C during the run

mobility_note: negative ions in humid air (~20 g/m3 water): expect ~1.8-2.2e-4; treat as fit parameter

supply.module: unbranded "DC 3-6V to 400kV" boost module (KitsGuru listing), pulsed output of unknown waveform
supply.battery: single 18650 Li-ion, 3.7 V nominal, 2000 mAh, 7.4 Wh
supply.note: 3.7 V open-circuit after charging is ~40-50% charge for Li-ion (full = 4.2 V); sags further under 2-5 A module load

spark_test.electrodes: straight bare copper output leads, flush-cut with wire cutter, tip to tip
spark_test.basis: needle-gap sparkover data (sharp cut tips); upper end allows for blunter tips and pulsed waveform

anemometer.position: hand-held, roughly on centreline, ~60 mm downstream of the back of the collector tubes
anemometer.display: readings shown with 0.01 m/s steps although the spec states 0.1 m/s resolution; values recorded as displayed
anemometer.vane_size: not documented; 25 mm assumed for averaging in the CFD comparison

background_flow: still air: fans off, away from windows; 0.00 m/s measured with thruster off (~48 s)

observation_smooth_vs_nicked.smooth_wire: very faint hiss, no airflow visible with incense-stick smoke
observation_smooth_vs_nicked.nicked_wire: clear hiss, visible flow; anemometer 1.21 m/s steady
observation_smooth_vs_nicked.implied_current_ratio: (1.21 / v_smoke)^2 = ~40-150x for a smoke threshold of 0.1-0.2 m/s, assuming the same flow losses
